sections.title: Baton Rouge Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Baton Rouge's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Petrochemical and Refining (The Chemical Corridor's Capital)
paragraphs: The Baton Rouge to New Orleans industrial corridor — sometimes called 'Cancer Alley' by critics or the 'Chemical Corridor' by industry — houses some of the world's largest individual chemical plants and refineries:

ExxonMobil Baton Rouge Refinery: One of the world's largest refineries, producing gasoline, diesel, and chemicals from crude oil. AI for: Crude oil optimization ML — selecting optimal crude oil blend to maximize product value given market prices, feedstock availability, and refinery constraints. Predictive maintenance from refinery unit sensor data — FCC (Fluid Catalytic Cracker), hydrotreater, distillation tower performance prediction. Environmental emissions monitoring and compliance prediction.

BASF, Honeywell UOP, Albemarle, and the broader chemical plant community: The largest chemical plants in the US are clustered along the Louisiana River Road. AI for: Process optimization from DCS (Distributed Control System) and historian data. Heat exchanger fouling prediction and cleaning scheduling. Plant-wide energy optimization.

Turner Industries and EPC contractors: The large engineering, procurement, and construction companies managing Louisiana's industrial turnarounds and capital projects: Turnaround scope estimation and duration prediction. Construction project safety analytics and incident prediction. Workforce scheduling optimization for large industrial turnarounds.
Cost: $50,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Our Lady of the Lake Regional Medical Center (Baton Rouge HQ, Franciscan Missionaries of Our Lady Health System), Baton Rouge General Medical Center, and LSU Health System (LSU School of Medicine New Orleans with Baton Rouge clinical programs). HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Baton Rouge's health systems.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Louisiana State Government
paragraphs: Baton Rouge is Louisiana's state capital — the Louisiana Department of Revenue, Department of Children and Family Services, and other Louisiana state agencies create government analytics and document processing AI demand.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Agriculture (Louisiana's Distinctive Crops)

Rice water management and yield prediction.

sections.title: Louisiana's Industrial AI Context
sections.description: Louisiana's industrial AI market has characteristics that make Baton Rouge a unique but significant AI opportunity.

blocks.heading: OSIsoft PI is nearly universal
paragraphs: Every major chemical plant and refinery in Louisiana's chemical corridor runs OSIsoft PI (now AVEVA PI System) as the primary process historian. ClickMasters designs Baton Rouge industrial AI with PI data extraction, feature engineering from time-series historian data, and PI OLEDB integration as standard — not as a specialized capability.

blocks.heading: Environmental compliance pressure
paragraphs: Louisiana's industrial facilities face growing EPA, LDEQ, and community pressure on environmental emissions. Environmental monitoring AI — stack emission prediction, flare system optimization, and LDEQ air quality compliance analytics — is growing from a nice-to-have to a must-have for Baton Rouge's chemical industry.

blocks.heading: Storm preparation and resilience
paragraphs: Louisiana's hurricane exposure creates specific operational AI requirements for Baton Rouge's industrial facilities — storm preparation optimization, emergency response analytics, and post-storm restart prediction for chemical plants that require complex restart sequences.
